note: Questions that must be answered before a decision can be made reasonably. 'Blocking' means the decision cannot proceed until the question is answered. 'Brief only' in the source column means no official source exists for the question.

questions.question: Does each submitted short link reach the product its identifier was meant to reach?
questions.have: Observed redirect targets for P1, P2 and P5 (different ASINs). P3 and P4 are open: the two short links were recorded in opposite directions by different sessions.
questions.missing: A confirmed listing for each intended identifier, and the owner's intended product for each link.
questions.how_to_discover: Open each short link in a signed-in browser. Note the ASIN in the URL after /dp/ and in Product information. Compare with the intended identifier.

questions.question: Are the five intended identifiers valid Amazon ASINs?
questions.have: Each is 9 characters with lowercase letters. An ASIN is 10 characters (SRC-12).
questions.missing: The original source of each identifier.
questions.how_to_discover: Ask the person who supplied the links where each identifier came from. Check the listing title against the product you intend.

questions.question: Is the tracking ID shopnow047c-20 an active ID in an enrolled Associates account, and is it on each link?
questions.have: User-supplied ID. Observed destinations contain no tag= parameter.
questions.missing: Account view in Associates Central; test-click results in the Associates tracking report.
questions.how_to_discover: In Associates Central, confirm the ID. Generate one Special Link for one product and click it from a test browser. Check the tracking report. Only then scale.

questions.question: Are the submitted link.amazon short links permitted on the site?
questions.have: Owner brief says compliance is unresolved (FLG-003). No official document describing this domain was found.
questions.missing: An official ruling or a written answer from Associates support.
questions.how_to_discover: Contact Associates support through the Contact form linked from the Program Policies page. Ask about link.amazon links specifically. Do not assume either way.

questions.question: Has this GitHub Pages URL been registered as a Site in the Associates application?
questions.have: Participation Requirements §1 says Sites must be identified in the application.
questions.missing: Confirmation of the registered Site URL in Associates Central.
questions.how_to_discover: In Associates Central, check the Site(s) listed on the account. Add the Pages URL if it is not listed.

questions.question: What are the five defined measurement events?
questions.have: The brief refers to them but does not list them. A proposed list is on the Measurement page.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner to supply the list. Until then nothing is recorded.

questions.question: Where will the analytics endpoint and outbound-click counter run?
questions.have: GitHub Pages serves static files only. The click hook is built and sends nothing unless an endpoint is set.
questions.missing: A server or serverless host the owner controls, and a decision on what is stored.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner to choose a host and retention period. Any analytics or cookie use must be disclosed on the site (SRC-02 §3(e)).

questions.question: Should the site show prices and availability at all?
questions.have: SRC-02 §2(b) allows prices only if Amazon serves the link or through Creators API / PA API. The site currently shows none.
questions.missing: A decision on API access, and whether eligibility is met.
questions.how_to_discover: Read the API terms on the Program Policies page and check eligibility in Associates Central.

questions.question: What are the commission rates by category?
questions.have: The schedule URL exists (SRC-03) but was not readable without sign-in.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner to sign in to Associates and read the Standard Commission Income schedule, then supply figures.

questions.question: Is P4 (intended B0c8moW59) reachable and which category does it belong to?
questions.how_to_discover: Retest the short link from a signed-in browser after Q01.

questions.question: Which product set is intended: these five, or a set chosen by research?
questions.have: Five submitted links. Three air fryers, one meat thermometer, one unknown.
questions.missing: The owner's selection criteria and any research output.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner to define criteria. Research requires first-party data (see Q12).

questions.question: Where will real click, order, and traffic data come from?
questions.have: The campaign ledger is empty and has a provenance column.
questions.missing: Authorized first-party reports (Associates reports; Search Console for search queries).
questions.how_to_discover: Owner to export Associates reports and verify the Search Console property, then add rows with source and date.

questions.question: What brand name, byline, and contact address should appear?
questions.how_to_discover: Owner to supply the details. No author is invented.

questions.question: Does the site copy comply with the Amazon Trademark Guidelines?
questions.have: The Guidelines are linked from the Program Policies page but were not read in this session.
questions.how_to_discover: Read the Trademark Guidelines on the Program Policies page and compare against the site copy.

questions.question: How often should guides be published?
questions.have: No cadence was set in the brief.
questions.how_to_discover: Pick a cadence from the options on the Suggestions page. Measure after 28 days.
